calculation.description: Reverse each instrument's cross-sectional relative three-session return only when the fraction of instruments with negative five-session returns indicates broad downside stress. Cross-sectional z-scoring is performed using information available at the signal date. Positive values indicate preferred rebound candidates.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC/ICIR by regime: 2020-2022 +0.0162602/+0.0449935 (63 dates); 2023-2024 +0.0437040/+0.1196643 (33 dates); 2025-2027 +0.0524626/+0.1658903 (38 dates). The full-window daily IC and ICIR exceed benchmark gates of absolute IC 0.0070 and absolute ICIR 0.0840. Five-day result is based on only 9 valid dates and is treated as exploratory, not admission evidence.
